<span class="hl-kw">&lt;?php</span>

<span class="hl-kw">declare</span>(<span class="hl-kw">strict_types</span>=<span class="hl-num">1</span>);

<span class="hl-kw">namespace</span> Flowcatalyst\Events\Solo\Domain\Aggregate;

<span class="hl-kw">final</span> <span class="hl-kw">readonly</span> <span class="hl-kw">class</span> UnknownEventData
{
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> __construct(
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">string</span> <span class="hl-var">$status</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">int</span> <span class="hl-var">$level</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">mixed</span> <span class="hl-var">$mode</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">string</span> <span class="hl-var">$kind</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">string</span> <span class="hl-var">$version</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">string</span> <span class="hl-var">$flag</span>,
    ) {}

    <span class="hl-comment">/** @param array&lt;string, mixed&gt; $data */</span>
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">static</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> fromArray(<span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$data</span>): <span class="hl-kw">self</span>
    {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">new</span> <span class="hl-kw">self</span>(
            status: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'status'</span>],
            level: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'level'</span>],
            mode: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'mode'</span>],
            kind: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'kind'</span>],
            version: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'version'</span>],
            flag: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'flag'</span>],
        );
    }

    <span class="hl-comment">/** @return array&lt;string, mixed&gt; */</span>
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> toArray(): <span class="hl-kw">array</span>
    {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> [
            <span class="hl-str">'status'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;status,
            <span class="hl-str">'level'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;level,
            <span class="hl-str">'mode'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;mode,
            <span class="hl-str">'kind'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;kind,
            <span class="hl-str">'version'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;version,
            <span class="hl-str">'flag'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;flag,
        ];
    }
}
